description: This is a Java class that configures Spring Security with JWT-based authentication. It defines beans for password encoding, user details service, authentication manager, and security filter chain, setting up security rules for web requests.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Spring Security configuration class implementing security settings using JWT tokens.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Defines a bean for password encoding using BCrypt.

methods.name: userDetailsService
methods.description: Defines a bean that retrieves user details from UserService.

methods.name: authenticationManager
methods.description: Creates an AuthenticationManager using UserDetailsService and PasswordEncoder.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Configures the security filter chain, disabling CSRF, setting request matchers and restrictions, and adding JWT authentication filter.
